reviews.title: Great All-in-One Security Solution
reviews.comment: McAfee Total Protection works flawlessly across all my devices. It’s easy to install, runs smoothly in the background, and provides strong protection without slowing down my system. The VPN, password manager, and ID monitoring are very useful, and the AI scam detection adds extra peace of mind. Excellent value for unlimited devices—highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jerry Song

reviews.title: Works quickly, protects you and is safe
reviews.comment: I absolutely love this total protection for my laptop and my cell phone. You can also usually add a person onto that account if you want to. Which is also helpful. It definitely protects me from hackers and things like that. It’s compatible with all my iOS devices. The quality is great, it’s so easy to use. You can run scans anytime you want. It works quickly and efficiently. This is about the third time I have bought the same item.
reviews.author: Casey

reviews.title: Surprisingly Simple First Digital Product Experience
reviews.comment: This was the first digital product I’ve ever purchased, and I was surprised by how easy it was to set everything up. The compatibility with my devices was perfect, and the software quality feels very reliable. I really like the clear update status notifications — it keeps everything running smoothly. The overall ease of use is great, even for someone who isn’t very technical. For the price, the value for money is excellent, especially considering all the features included. The speed of activation and installation was fast
reviews.author: Angela | Lifestyle Creator • Cat Mom

reviews.title: Does not work with Mac Big Sur and Monterey
reviews.comment: Updates: Q&A says "version 4.10.0.0 or later of McAfee security software for macOS" would work with Big Sur. My version is 4.11 and still not working. I have Big Sur and recently Monterey, but errors kept saying "At Risk" for more than a year since the previous subscription, that gives an impression of Mcafee is not working as advertised. I did uninstall and install a few times but nothing improved. Identify protection says data was bleached and I have to change the account password, but I do not have any account there. What is working: Real time scanning, Automatic updates, Scheduled scans, Part of identify protection (Identity protection score) - go to your web account>Access your identity protection service. it does not slow my Mac down, while Norton slows it down. What is not working: Firewall, VPN in Mac (it says available but no function anywhere that is supposed to be), The early 2021 iOS app does not come with VPN; VPN comes with only the latest 2021 app, so it was not available until recently. Part of identify protection (Web protection), Web advisor (an error says at risk) May be or may not be working: Subscription (says your subscription was expired repeatedly before the expiration date- it is annoying to see the message "you are not protected"), iOS protection (iphone app looked like protecting initially, but it kept giving strange messages, including "no subscription" or "6 month subscription" when I have one year subscription. Confusing is that unlimited VPN does NOT come with unlimited device subscription.  I used up limited VPN in a few days, so it is useless. MCafee safe browsing is given an option that turns on as needed, but when I use it, Safari gets very slow and does not load some of the websites. To get an unlimited VPN, you have to get + VPN subscription (for example, 10 devices + VPN). --- I have used this for a long time and bought this again for this year. Pros: McAfee has been the only one that does not slow down my computer. I tried Norton but it made it very slow. Others have other problems. The price is ok. Cons: It does not look like working as computer protection soft. It gives me various errors, "subscription expired (this is new)", "firewall not working with Big Sur", "need access to the computer (it does have full access)." The main functions are not working and I am not sure about the other functions.
reviews.author: nmrs
